verses.text: 1. Amma Theodora asked Archbishop Theophilus about some words of the apostle saying, ’What does this mean, ”Knowing how to profit by circumstances”?’ (Col. 4, 5) He said to her, ’This sayings shews us how to profit at all times. For example; is it a time of excess for you? By humility and patience buy up the time of excess, and draw profit from it. Is it the time of shame? Buy it up by means of resignation and win it. So everything that goes against us can, if we wish, become profitable to us.’
